actions.description: Publish a JointTrajectory on the Servo output topic; the receipt reports publication only, never execution or stopping
actions.name: publish_joint_trajectory

facts.text: The repository provides Franka Emika Panda software packages that enable manipulation with MoveIt 2 inside Gazebo and use gz_ros2_control for control.
The branch targets ROS 2 Galactic and Gazebo Fortress.
panda_moveit_config's README says move_group.launch.py configures MoveIt 2 to plan motions inside a simulation and that the real robot is not yet supported.
The README's ign_control example executes motions with simulated controllers.
servo.yaml sets command_out_type to trajectory_msgs/JointTrajectory.
servo.yaml sets command_out_topic to /joint_trajectory_controller/joint_trajectory.
servo.yaml sets move_group_name to arm.
servo.yaml sets incoming_command_timeout to 0.25, commented 'Stop servoing if X seconds elapse without a new command', and num_outgoing_halt_msgs_to_publish to 1.
moveit_controller_manager.yaml lists joint_trajectory_controller and gripper_trajectory_controller as the controller names.
The joint_trajectory_controller entry uses action_ns follow_joint_trajectory, type FollowJointTrajectory and is the default controller.
controllers_effort.yaml configures the controller manager at 250 Hz with a joint_state_broadcaster and two joint_trajectory_controller instances.
controllers_effort.yaml gives the arm joint_trajectory_controller the seven panda_joint names, the effort command interface and position and velocity state interfaces.
panda.ros2_control declares a ros2_control system whose hardware plugin is fake_components/GenericSystem for the fake plugin and ign_ros2_control/IgnitionSystem for the ign plugin.
panda.gazebo loads the ign_ros2_control-system plugin with the controller parameter file.
The generated URDF declares lower and upper position limits for the seven revolute panda_joint joints.
initial_joint_positions.yaml starts the arm at joint1 0, joint2 -0.7853981633974483, joint3 0, joint4 -2.356194490192345, joint5 0, joint6 1.5707963267948966 and joint7 0.7853981633974483.
The SRDF defines the arm chain from panda_link0 to panda_hand_tcp.
move_group.launch.py starts moveit_servo's servo_node_main with the servo parameters when enable_servo is true.
move_group.launch.py declares ros2_control_command_interface with default effort and enable_servo with default true.
move_group.launch.py spawns every controller named in moveit_controller_manager.yaml plus joint_state_broadcaster.
ex_ign_control.launch.py launches Ignition Gazebo with the -r flag and includes move_group.launch.py with the ign ros2_control plugin and the effort command interface.
ex_ign_control.launch.py bridges /clock from Ignition to rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock.
panda_ign_moveit2.repos pulls ros_ign galactic, ign_ros2_control devel and ros2_controllers jtc_effort from external repositories.
panda_moveit_config/package.xml depends on control_msgs, controller_manager, joint_trajectory_controller, moveit_servo and moveit.

determinism.notes: Event-driven recording stand-in with no physics step, trajectory interpolation, controller timing, feedback or wall-clock pacing; the placeholder trajectory recording does not establish trajectory or state-hash replay

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS recording fake (no Gazebo or MoveIt physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it records the advertised and published JointTrajectory messages and runs no Gazebo, gz_ros2_control, MoveIt Servo, joint_trajectory_controller or ROS graph

the publication is not an acknowledged command: the fake cannot show controller acceptance, interpolation, execution, timing, feedback, collision behaviour or a stopped state, and the receipt always reports confirmed=false
the last trajectory the fake stores is placeholder test data; a live run must publish through the operator's rosbridge and observe the controller separately

the acknowledged FollowJointTrajectory action used by MoveIt is not exposed: the clone only names the short type FollowJointTrajectory and an exec_depend on control_msgs, so the exact control_msgs wire type cannot be cited at this pin
the /joint_states observation, /move_action planning interface, gripper controller, /clock and Gazebo model/physics are out of scope
no source-backed stop, pause, controller-switch or safe-state action is declared; the runtime software latch is not an independent stop and does not interrupt an accepted trajectory

move_group.launch.py starts MoveIt Servo by default (enable_servo true), and Servo publishes its outgoing commands on the same /joint_trajectory_controller/joint_trajectory topic this package publishes to; move_group also executes plans through the same controller's follow_joint_trajectory action; neither is fenced by the MHS latch
ex_ign_control.launch.py starts Gazebo running (-r), so an accepted trajectory keeps executing in the free-running simulation after an e-stop

operator_required.reason: the pinned clone declares no nanosecond range for time_from_start; the operator supplies the deployed controller's timing bound

operator_required.reason: the pinned clone declares no trajectory time_from_start envelope for the Servo output topic; the operator supplies the deployed controller's timing bound

safe_state.description: No source-backed stop, pause, controller-switch or safe-state endpoint is declared in the pinned clone: the only verifiable command endpoint is the Servo outgoing JointTrajectory publication, so the runtime's software latch refuses further publications but cannot interrupt a trajectory the external controller has already accepted, does not fence Servo or move_group, and this package claims no stopped state.
